traceability.notes: All acceptance criteria and technical requirements of docs/stories/003.0-DEV-FUNCTION-ANNOTATIONS.story.md are implemented and verified. The ESLint rules `require-story-annotation` and `require-req-annotation` share a common function-detection scope and exportPriority model, enforce their respective annotations on the required function-like constructs (including TSDeclareFunction and TSMethodSignature), exclude arrow functions from traceability requirements by default, and use robust JSDoc/comment parsing helpers. Error messages are clear and actionable, error locations are anchored on function identifiers or equivalent nodes, and both rules are thoroughly documented and tested. The full Jest test suite passes, including multiple suites explicitly tied to this story, so this story is assessed as PASSED.
